# has skill

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSkill`](gmeow-hasSkill.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSkill>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)

Relates an agent to a skill it possesses. Non-functional — an agent may have many skills. The leveled, scaled detail is carried by the reified [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-SkillProficiency.md).
